core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling to PI3K–AKT and ERK
name: IGF1R–IRS and ALK/LTK signalling to PI3K–AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are RTK autophosphorylation and downstream PI3K/AKT, SOS and ERK signalling; IRS/IGF1R and ALK/LTK inputs separate it from the ERBB/MET confusables and the RAS/MAPK attenuation theme.

name: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism via cytosolic sulfonation
rationale: All three members concern biotransformation of xenobiotics and steroids, with sulfonation conjugation distinguishing it from the CYP oxidation and acetylation/amino-acid conjugation confusables.

name: Actin severing, capping and crosslinking in leading-edge motility
rationale: Members regulate actin filament turnover at lamellipodia, ruffles and pseudopodia for cell migration; severing, capping, depolymerization and crosslinking distinguish it from the Arp2/3–WAVE, filopodium and focal-adhesion confusables.

core: Phase II conjugation of aromatic xenobiotics
qualifier: glycine and glutamine amino acid conjugation
name: Aromatic xenobiotic phase II conjugation with glycine and glutamine
rationale: Members are conjugation reactions (acetylation, methylation, amino acid conjugation) and CYP2E1/paracetamol detoxification of benzene-containing compounds; glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate separates it from the drug-ADME and CYP oxidation confusables.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral transcriptional signature
rationale: All members are type I IFN/antiviral gene signatures (including IRF2 target networks), distinguishing it from confusables built on specific effectors such as ISG15, OAS and PKR.

name: Gluconeogenesis from alanine, glycerol and fructose precursors
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis and metabolism of its substrates (alanine, oxaloacetate, glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate, alditols, fructose), with phosphocreatine as an outlier; biosynthetic gluconeogenic flow separates it from fructose catabolism disorders and the pentose phosphate shunt.

name: Lung epithelial cell differentiation and saccular maturation
rationale: Members are late lung development steps (type I/II pneumocyte, secretory and bronchial epithelium differentiation, saccule development, plus perinatal ductus closure), distinct from surfactant metabolism and branching/mesenchymal growth confusables.

core: Regulation of NK cell activation and cytotoxicity
name: NK cell cytotoxicity regulation via MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members concern NK receptor activation, degranulation and cytokine output and inhibitory lymphoid–non-lymphoid interactions including MHC class Ib presentation, distinguishing it from T-cell costimulation and KIR/tolerance confusables.

core: Phospholipid translocation and transfer between membranes
name: Aminophospholipid flipping and intermembrane phosphatidylinositol transfer
rationale: Members cover P4-ATPase aminophospholipid translocation and ER–Golgi PI/PC transfer and PI synthesis, separating it from glycolipid transport, ER tubule shaping and calcium-activated scrambling confusables.

core: Double-stranded RNA sensing and its restraint
qualifier: TLR3 pathway deficiency, PKR and ADAR editing
name: Double-stranded RNA sensing by TLR3/PKR and ADAR editing
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3–TICAM1–TRAF3 signalling (and its HSE deficiencies), PKR and ADAR A-to-I editing with negative regulation of type I IFN, narrower than the broad antiviral confusable and distinct from TLR3-induced cell death.

core: Integrin–extracellular matrix adhesion and cell migration
name: Integrin–fibronectin matrix adhesion and stress-fibre-driven cell migration
rationale: Members concern ECM/integrin and syndecan interactions, fibronectin matrix, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly promoting fibroblast/endothelial migration, distinct from MET-driven cell spreading, Rho effector and EMT confusables.

name: Sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona pellucida binding
rationale: All members concern sperm preparation and binding to the oocyte, distinct from sperm motility/flagellum assembly and maternal-to-zygotic transition confusables.

core: Regulation of cytosolic nucleic acid sensing to interferon-beta
qualifier: negative regulators of RIG-I and cGAS–STING
name: Negative regulation of RIG-I and cGAS–STING interferon-beta induction
rationale: Members regulate IFN-beta/alpha production from RIG-I/MDA5 and cGAS–STING sensing, predominantly as negative regulators (TREX1, DDX58/IFIH1 inhibitors), unlike the confusables built on positive IRF3/TBK1 activation.

name: Proximal tubule organic cation, anion and cystine transport
rationale: Members are SLC plasma-membrane transport modules with organic cation/anion, alpha-ketoglutarate and cystine (cystinuria) transport and proximal tubule development, distinguishing it from urate and neutral amino acid transporter confusables.

name: Telomere capping, protection and recombination-based maintenance
rationale: All members concern telomere end protection (capping, NHEJ and recombination inhibition, packaging) and recombination/replication-based maintenance, distinct from C-strand synthesis and general DNA topology/repair confusables.

name: Amino acid transport featuring cationic lysine, arginine and ornithine
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane and mitochondrial amino acid transport; cationic amino acid and ornithine transport (LPI, HHH syndrome) separates it from peptide, polyamine and tryptophan transport confusables.

name: NGF signalling through TRKA and p75NTR
rationale: Members cover NGF processing and TRKA downstream signalling plus p75NTR survival/death signalling, distinguishing it from TRKB/TRKC confusables and from p75NTR-free or dependence-receptor themes.

qualifier: DNA glycosylase recognition and its defects
name: Glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and glycosylase defects
rationale: Members are DNA glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged bases, APEX1 displacement and defective OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1/NEIL variants, distinct from gap-filling BER and direct alkylation reversal confusables.

name: Dopamine receptor signalling and dopaminergic synaptic transmission
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor G-protein, arrestin and PLC signalling and dopaminergic synaptic/behavioural regulation, distinct from drug-response, dopamine synthesis/transport and neuropeptide confusables.

name: Microtubule nucleation, stabilisation and centrosome positioning
rationale: Most members concern MTOC microtubule nucleation, stabilisation and centrosome localization (with CIT and actin localization as outliers), distinct from spindle orientation, mitotic centrosome recruitment and cilium confusables.

name: Lung branching morphogenesis and mesenchymal proliferation
rationale: All members concern lung bud branching, growth and lung mesenchyme proliferation, distinct from generic epithelial–mesenchymal signalling, trachea and saccular differentiation confusables.

name: Receptor internalisation targeting lysosomal degradation rather than recycling
rationale: Members promote receptor (incl. GPCR) clathrin-mediated internalisation and lysosomal catabolism while suppressing recycling, distinct from LDL-receptor and recycling/caveolar confusables.

core: Vitamin K and vitamin C metabolism
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation plus ascorbate metabolism/transport and responses, distinguishing it from vitamin A/D and vitamin E/ubiquinol confusables.

name: Sphingolipid metabolism and non-vesicular lipid transfer at ER contacts
rationale: Members cover sphingolipid/ceramide synthesis, catabolism and homeostasis plus intermembrane lipid transfer and ER tethering, distinct from glycerophospholipid remodelling, lysosomal glycosphingolipid and vesicular Golgi confusables.

name: Phenylalanine, tyrosine and histidine catabolism with BH4 cofactor
rationale: Members cover phenylalanine/tyrosine catabolism (including phenylketonuria), tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis, histidine catabolism and formate metabolism, distinct from proline/threonine and generic amino acid confusables.
